target: the estimated COST changes with the assumed output size — an input-only estimate would price both efforts identically and silently understate every call
cmd: cat "$FIXTURES/preflight/brief-large.json" | MOCK_RESPONSE_FILE="$FIXTURES/sol-transport/openai-ok.json" bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/call_sol.sh" --mode adversary --effort standard 2>&1 >/dev/null | grep -o 'estimated cost [0-9.]*' | grep -o '[0-9.]*' > cs; cat "$FIXTURES/preflight/brief-large.json" | MOCK_RESPONSE_FILE="$FIXTURES/sol-transport/openai-ok.json" bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/call_sol.sh" --mode adversary --effort max 2>&1 >/dev/null | grep -o 'estimated cost [0-9.]*' | grep -o '[0-9.]*' > cm; echo "standard=$(cat cs) max=$(cat cm)"; [ -s cs ] && [ -s cm ] && [ "$(cat cs)" != "$(cat cm)" ] && echo OUTPUT_IS_PRICED
